body: SUPPLEMENT TO THE SAME BLOCK before a recut: the whitelist misses three proven legal Scala 3 forms, not only transparent. Exact 3.7.4 compilation succeeds for transparent trait plus consumer, top-level implicit class plus consumer, and infix type plus consumer. Independent reference-scope fixtures for each return exit 0 and no types defined, omitting core and features. Formal register replaced by op 20260831T182239.804351Z-p26690-c0000-r9adb-h11ac83. Required successor should cover transparent, implicit, and infix in the shared BASE/HEAD recognizer and court them; the documented opaque exclusion may remain. This is the same false-negative mechanism, consolidated now to avoid another one-word recut.
